article_content: Michael Schumacher's severe ski mishap in the French Alps has again highlighted the importance of slope safety. The seven-time Formula One champion remains in critical condition after striking his head on a rock on Sunday at the Meribel resort. However, Dr. Mike Langran, a Scottish physician who specializes in ski safety, insists that major incidents like this are not common. He stated that accidents of this magnitude are thankfully rare, though they inevitably draw significant media coverage. Dr. Langran, who was interviewed by CNN on skiing safety last January, expressed deep concern on hearing about Schumacher's accident. He wished him a fast and full recovery but stressed that injury risks in snow sports are generally minimal. He reiterated that while no recreational activity is entirely free of hazards, the overall likelihood of getting hurt during skiing or snowboarding remains quite low—around 2-4 injuries for every 1,000 days spent on the slopes. 'Most people will ski or snowboard their entire lives without encountering a serious mishap,' Langran noted, pointing out that winter sports often receive negative publicity regarding safety. He compared the 2-3 injuries per 1,000 participants per day in skiing to soccer or rugby, suggesting those sports can see equal or greater numbers of incidents but involve comparatively fewer players at any given time. Langran also mentioned that, over the past decade in the U.S., an average of 41.5 individuals died each year from skiing or snowboarding, amounting to a 0.78 fatality rate per million participant visits. As a comparison, he highlighted that in 2009, 2,400 people drowned while swimming in public areas and 800 died in bicycle accidents in the United States. Schumacher is receiving treatment at the University Hospital Center of Grenoble. Medical staff said it is too soon to make a prognosis regarding the former Formula One driver's outcome. Upon arrival, he was comatose and needed immediate brain surgery. He has undergone one operation and remains in a medically induced coma. Reports indicate that Schumacher was wearing a helmet when he fell. According to doctors at Grenoble, he likely would not have reached surgery in time without this protective gear. Langran endorses proper helmet use, acknowledging that while helmets cannot prevent every possible injury, they can substantially lessen the severity of harm sustained. Since 2006, the International Ski Federation (FIS) has recommended helmets on the slopes, though they are still an individual choice. Some travel insurers have made them a requirement, warning that any claim might be voided if the injured person was not wearing a helmet.
translated_content: Kemalangan ski serius Michael Schumacher di Alps Perancis sekali lagi menonjolkan kepentingan keselamatan di cerun. Juara Formula Satu tujuh kali itu kini dalam keadaan kritikal selepas terhantuk pada batu pada hari Ahad di pusat peranginan Meribel. Namun begitu, Dr. Mike Langran, seorang doktor Scotland yang pakar dalam keselamatan ski, menegaskan bahawa insiden besar seperti ini jarang berlaku. Beliau menyatakan bahawa kemalangan sebesar ini amat jarang, walaupun ia pasti menarik perhatian media yang meluas. Dr. Langran, yang ditemu bual oleh CNN mengenai keselamatan ski pada Januari lalu, meluahkan kebimbangan mendalam mengenai kemalangan Schumacher. Beliau mendoakan pemulihan yang cepat dan menyeluruh, namun menekankan bahawa risiko kecederaan sukan salji secara keseluruhan adalah rendah. Beliau menegaskan bahawa walaupun tiada aktiviti rekreasi yang bebas sepenuhnya daripada bahaya, kebarangkalian untuk cedera semasa bermain ski atau papan salji kekal agak rendah—kira-kira 2-4 kecederaan bagi setiap 1,000 hari di cerun. 'Kebanyakan orang akan bermain ski atau papan salji sepanjang hidup mereka tanpa mengalami kejadian serius,' kata Langran, sambil menjelaskan bahawa sukan musim sejuk sering mendapat liputan negatif tentang aspek keselamatan. Beliau membandingkan 2-3 kecederaan bagi setiap 1,000 peserta sehari dalam sukan ski dengan bola sepak atau ragbi, menunjukkan kedua-dua sukan itu boleh mencatat jumlah insiden sama atau lebih tinggi, walaupun jumlah pemainnya lebih kecil pada satu-satu masa. Langran turut menyebut, sepanjang satu dekad lalu di AS, secara purata 41.5 individu meninggal dunia setiap tahun akibat bermain ski atau papan salji, bersamaan kadar 0.78 kematian bagi setiap sejuta kunjungan pemain. Untuk perbandingan, beliau menekankan bahawa pada tahun 2009, 2,400 orang lemas ketika berenang di kawasan awam dan 800 lagi meninggal dunia akibat kemalangan basikal di Amerika Syarikat. Schumacher sedang menerima rawatan di Pusat Hospital Universiti Grenoble. Kakitangan perubatan berkata masih terlalu awal untuk meramal keadaan bekas pemandu Formula Satu itu. Apabila tiba, beliau dalam keadaan koma dan memerlukan pembedahan otak segera. Beliau telah menjalani satu pembedahan dan masih diletakkan dalam koma teraruh. Laporan menunjukkan Schumacher memakai topi keledar sewaktu terjatuh. Menurut doktor di Grenoble, beliau mungkin tidak sempat dibawa untuk pembedahan jika tidak memakai perlindungan tersebut. Langran menyokong pemakaian topi keledar yang sesuai, sambil menegaskan bahawa walaupun topi keledar tidak dapat mencegah semua kecederaan, ia dapat mengurangkan tahap kecederaan dengan ketara. Sejak tahun 2006, Persekutuan Ski Antarabangsa (FIS) telah mengesyorkan pemakaian topi keledar semasa berada di cerun, walaupun penggunaan masih bersifat sukarela. Namun, sesetengah syarikat insurans perjalanan kini mewajibkannya, dengan amaran bahawa tuntutan mungkin terbatal jika pemain ski tidak memakai topi keledar.

article_content: Defending champions Egypt punched their ticket to the African Nations Cup semifinals by overcoming Cameroon 3-1 after extra time in a tense encounter. The game garnered controversy when referee Jerome Damon allowed Ahmed Hassan's third goal to count, even though replays indicated the ball may never have crossed the line. Earlier, the Egyptian captain, celebrating his 170th cap, scored an own goal in the 26th minute, giving Cameroon an early edge. He later redeemed himself with a fierce long-range shot just before halftime, leveling the score and forcing extra time. Soon after play resumed, Mohamed Gedo pounced on a poor back pass from Geremi Njitap to put Egypt up 2-1. Moments later, Hassan's free-kick bounced off the crossbar and appeared to stay out, but the referee awarded a goal, widening the lead to 3-1. Cameroon's Aurelien Chedjou was shown a straight red card late on, as Egypt set up a semifinal clash with Algeria. Meanwhile, Nigeria defeated Zambia 5-4 on penalties in a sluggish quarterfinal that remained scoreless through 120 minutes, booking a semifinal battle with Ghana.

article_content: Tony and Julie Fuller, from Sunbury in Surrey, lost their only daughter Samantha on Christmas Eve when she was 28 years old. In her memory, they planted a tree at Cedars Park, hoping to install a plaque dedicated to her. However, Spelthorne Borough Council informed them that such plaques are no longer permitted due to complaints that they are depressing. The Fullers feel devastated, asserting that the plaques do no harm and help them honor their daughter, who passed away from Wegener’s granulomatosis. Jackie Taylor, head of Streetscene at the council, explained that several people complained about seeing too many memorial plaques throughout the park, prompting the ban. While the council does not oppose planting trees, it believes a plaque is unnecessary, and the policy now extends to benches as well.

Walau bagaimanapun, Majlis Daerah Spelthorne memberitahu mereka bahawa plak seperti itu tidak lagi dibenarkan kerana aduan bahawa ia terlalu menyedihkan. Keluarga Fuller berasa sangat kecewa, menegaskan bahawa plak itu tidak mendatangkan sebarang masalah dan membantu mereka menghormati anak perempuan mereka, yang meninggal dunia akibat granulomatosis Wegener. Jackie Taylor, ketua Streetscene di majlis tersebut, menjelaskan bahawa beberapa orang mengadu tentang terlalu banyak plak peringatan di sekitar taman, menyebabkan larangan tersebut. Walaupun majlis tidak menghalang penanaman pokok, mereka merasakan plak tidak diperlukan, dan dasar ini turut terpakai kepada bangku di sana.

article_content: Scientists now understand that mushrooms have an extraordinary ability to influence the weather around them, allowing them to disperse their spores more effectively. By adjusting moisture levels in the air, mushrooms create tiny winds that carry spores away, ensuring they travel over wide distances. Although many plants rely on gravity, forceful ejection, wind, water, or animals to spread seeds, mushrooms appear far from passive. Even in the absence of a breeze, mushrooms can cool surrounding air by releasing water vapor, setting up convection currents that lift spores and carry them off. This research, presented at the American Physical Society’s Division of Fluid Dynamics meeting in Pittsburgh, was led by Professor Emilie Dressaire of Trinity College in Hartford, Connecticut. Using high-speed filming and mathematical modeling on oyster and Shitake mushrooms, the team showed that these fungi can generate localized weather to ensure their spores travel. Mushrooms are technically the fruiting bodies of fungi. Each mushroom can produce millions of microscopic spores, which disperse in the hope of landing somewhere that supports fungal growth. While many mushrooms are harmless or even edible, some, like the deadly death cap, can be lethal in small amounts. Others cause diseases in plants, animals, and humans. Fungi are neither plants nor animals, having branched off from both kingdoms about one billion years ago. Unable to produce their own food through photosynthesis, fungi absorb nutrients from their environment. Some thrive in extreme conditions, even enduring intense radiation in space. During the 13-year mission of the Mir space station, mutated fungi caused ongoing damage to the equipment.

Walaupun tanpa angin, cendawan dapat menyejukkan udara sekitar dengan melepaskan wap air, mewujudkan arus perolakan yang mengangkat spora dan membawanya pergi. Penyelidikan ini, yang dibentangkan di mesyuarat Persatuan Fizik Amerika Bahagian Dinamik Bendalir di Pittsburgh, diketuai oleh Profesor Emilie Dressaire dari Trinity College di Hartford, Connecticut. Dengan menggunakan teknik penggambaran berkelajuan tinggi dan pemodelan matematik pada cendawan tiram serta Shitake, pasukan ini menunjukkan bahawa kulat ini boleh menjana cuaca setempat bagi memastikan spora mereka tersebar. Cendawan secara teknikalnya ialah badan berbuah bagi sesuatu kulat. Setiap cendawan mampu menghasilkan berjuta-juta spora mikroskopik, yang tersebar dengan harapan akan mendarat di lokasi yang sesuai untuk pertumbuhan kulat. Sesetengahnya mampu hidup dalam keadaan ekstrem, malah bertahan dalam sinaran kuat di angkasa lepas. Sepanjang 13 tahun misi stesen angkasa Mir, kulat bermutasi menyebabkan kerosakan berterusan pada peralatan.

article_content: When you think about an action movie, the first thing that comes to mind might not be the score. You might think of the actors, the plot, or the set pieces, but underneath every great action movie is an equally compelling score. These scores help you understand the tone of the movie and keep you engaged during the biggest moments in some of the best action films ever made. A great action score should be impressive on its own, yet also enhance the movie around it. The first Terminator movie laid the foundation for how these films could sound, but it was not until its famed sequel, T2, that we heard the ideal Terminator soundtrack. Featuring the distinctive, drum-heavy theme from the first film, T2's soundtrack gives the entire movie a grander atmosphere. James Cameron excels at making his movies feel monumental, and the T2 score reflects that. Brad Fiedel's music is a major reason you feel like T2 is one of the most important action films ever made. The iconic theme for Mission: Impossible dates all the way back to the original TV series, but Lorne Balfe's score for 2018's Fallout adds fresh ways to ramp up the tension. Fallout's score integrates the classic theme with additional compositions that perfectly accompany the film's extended action sequences. Top Gun, defined by Harold Faltermeyer's synth and guitar-heavy music, is a prime example of the 1980s approach to film scores. The movie's plot may be patchy, but its score provides the vibrant feel that cemented Top Gun as a decade-defining film. John Williams stands out with not one but two entries here. His Superman theme, complete with soaring trumpets, set a standard for superhero scores by making Superman feel like a timeless American idol. Decades later, this remains the tune most tied to the character. Meanwhile, his rousing work on Raiders of the Lost Ark is a call to adventure in its own right, capturing the spirit of Indy and the film's sweeping action scenes. With composers like Danny Elfman (Batman) and Hans Zimmer (Inception) also pushing boundaries, these scores carve out memorable identities for their respective movies.

Sementara itu, karya beliau yang bersemangat dalam Raiders of the Lost Ark seakan-akan panggilan untuk berpetualang, menangkap semangat Indy dan babak aksi yang memukau. Bersama komposer seperti Danny Elfman (Batman) dan Hans Zimmer (Inception) yang juga meneroka had baharu, skor-skornya berjaya membentuk identiti filem masing-masing.

article_content: (CNN) Libya's Foreign Ministry announced Thursday that it is expelling all Syrian diplomats due to the escalating government crackdown in Syria. Spokesman Saad Elshlmani stated that on Wednesday, the Syrian chargé d'affaires was summoned to the ministry in Tripoli and given 72 hours to depart with his staff. 'The reason for this is the Syrian regime's position toward its own people,' Elshlmani explained. 'Following the escalation of violence, Arab League meetings in Cairo, and ongoing draft resolutions, Libya found it necessary to adopt a stronger stance against the Syrian regime.' According to Syria's state news agency SANA, the Syrian consul in Libya, Mohammed al-Ghazawi, and his staff were attacked by gangs as they traveled to the Foreign Ministry. SANA reported that the gangs assaulted the diplomats' vehicles with clubs, knives, and cleavers, and also attacked and looted the Syrian Embassy. A number of other nations have expelled Syrian ambassadors over the violence, including Tunisia and the six member states of the Gulf Cooperation Council— the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, and Kuwait. Several countries, such as the United States, have closed or temporarily recalled their envoys from Damascus. CNN's Ivan Watson contributed to this report.

'Alasan untuk tindakan ini adalah pendirian rejim Syria terhadap rakyatnya sendiri,' jelas Elshlmani. 'Selepas peningkatan keganasan, mesyuarat Liga Arab di Kaherah, dan draf resolusi semasa, Libya merasakan ia perlu mengambil pendirian yang lebih tegas menentang rejim Syria.' Menurut agensi berita negeri Syria, SANA, konsul Syria di Libya, Mohammed al-Ghazawi, dan kakitangannya diserang oleh kumpulan samseng semasa dalam perjalanan ke Kementerian Luar. SANA melaporkan bahawa kumpulan tersebut menyerang kenderaan para diplomat dengan kayu, pisau, dan parang, serta turut menyerang dan menjarah Kedutaan Syria. Beberapa negara lain telah mengusir duta besar Syria akibat keganasan tersebut, termasuk Tunisia dan enam negara anggota Majlis Kerjasama Teluk— Emiriah Arab Bersatu, Bahrain, Arab Saudi, Oman, Qatar, dan Kuwait. Beberapa negara lain seperti Amerika Syarikat telah menutup atau memanggil pulang wakil mereka dari Damsyik buat sementara waktu. Ivan Watson dari CNN turut menyumbang kepada laporan ini.
